title: MZ TAABookMenu Not working with Visustella Main Menu core

posts.author: sskurai
posts.body: So I have been using the Visustella Main Menu core to delete a few menu options, and I'm also using the TAA book menu, but the book menu is not appearing whenever I remove the formation menu option. Is there any way to fix this?

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
My suggestion is you don't delete anything from Visustella's default parameters.
You can change its settings, let the 'show' property return false.
Or you can turn off TAA's auto place command and use Visustella to add a menu command, but it is harder to do.
